title: Quick 'trailer' to show prototype progress of my game Pitch Heroes
author: captain_proton

comments.author: captain_proton
comments.body:
The trailer is AI made (if it wasnt clear already) and I'm hoping its on the right tracks in terms of showing how the game plays at its current stage.

I'm very aware that some cuts/transitions are pretty rough, but before I go back to get it right, I was hoping to get some advice on how to improve it before I waste any more usage messing it up more!

Thanks!
